regulatory_benchmarks.origination_implication: Baseline straight-bet football hold (~5.05% annual) sets minimum vig hurdle a single-bet fair line must beat consistently.
Compound parlay margin is ~1.6x–4.1x straight football hold; parlays require verified positive unpriced joint correlation to be viable.
Aggregate sportsbook hold benchmark across all sports counters and pools.
Reflects blended mobile straight + SGP hold; underscores need for vig-stripped closing-line evaluation.

strategies.name: Opponent-Adjusted Trench & QB Availability Fair-Spread Originator
strategies.signal_mechanism: Originate fair point margin from play-level success rate, CPOE, Time-to-Throw, and verified T-90m starter/2nd/3rd-string QB & OL availability.

strategies.name: 2026 Kickoff-Regime & NWS Weather-Adjusted Total Originator
strategies.signal_mechanism: Model drive count and expected points under 2026 Rulebook kickoff/touchback rules (6-1-3, 6-1-5) conditioned on 60-min stadium roof lock & NWS wind/precip.

strategies.name: Multi-Slot Offensive Line Cascade Deficiency Signal
strategies.signal_mechanism: Trigger downward offensive efficiency adjustment when >=2 adjacent OL starters/swing backups are Out/DNP (modeled on verified NE LG/C Ben Brown Out + T Walter Rouse DNP pattern).

strategies.name: Boundary WR Separation vs. Promoted 2nd/3rd/4th-String CB Mismatch
strategies.signal_mechanism: Originate WR receiving-yard & target distributions when opposing CB1 is Out (e.g., NE Carlton Davis III Out -> CB2 Channing Canada; DET D.J. Reed DNP -> CB2–CB4 chain) using NGS Average Separation & Targeted Air Yards Share.

strategies.name: 3rd/4th-String RB Promotion Opportunity & Box-Count Share Model
strategies.signal_mechanism: Re-allocate rushing attempts & receiving checkdowns when RB1/RB2 are Out/DNP (e.g., NE RB2 TreVeyon Henderson Out + RB1 Rhamondre Stevenson DNP -> RB3 Corey Kiner / RB4 Lan Larison) adjusted for NGS 8+ Defenders in Box %.

strategies.name: Bivariate Copula Spread + Total Regime Parlay Pricer
strategies.signal_mechanism: Originate joint probability P(Spread & Total) via regime-conditioned simulation (underdog + Under in high-wind/backup-QB games; favorite + Over in indoor high-pace mismatches) and filter strictly against SGP vig.

strategies.name: QB Passing Yards + Primary WR/TE Air-Yards Share Joint Simulator
strategies.signal_mechanism: Jointly simulate team dropbacks, NGS Completion Probability (xCOMP), and receiver TAY% + xYAC to price QB Over + WR1 Over combos only when bookmaker implied correlation understates empirical lower-95% CI.

strategies.name: Trailing-Script Opposing Pass Volume + Favorite RB Carry Combo
strategies.signal_mechanism: Condition 2nd-half rush/pass play-calling splits on simulated halftime win probability when a 2nd/3rd-string QB (e.g., BAL 3rd-string QB Joe Fagnano) forces run-heavy or trailing-script asymmetries.

validation_gates.objective: Eliminate lookahead bias and unverified inputs.
validation_gates.pass_criteria: 100% of features carry immutable retrieval timestamps strictly prior to decision lock (e.g., T-85m post-Inactive List release); zero retroactive injury or roster overwrites.
Strict chronological expanding-window splits by NFL week/season with GroupKFold grouping on game_id so singles, parlays, and props from the same game never span train/test.

validation_gates.objective: Prove probabilistic accuracy independent of payout luck.
validation_gates.pass_criteria: Out-of-sample Log Loss and Brier Score beat vig-stripped market consensus, verified via reliability curves and Murphy resolution-minus-reliability decomposition.

validation_gates.gate_id: G4 · Closing Line Value (CLV) & Vig Hurdle
validation_gates.objective: Verify originated fair price beats sharp closing efficiency.
validation_gates.pass_criteria: Statistically positive mean CLV (in vig-free probability bps) after accounting for exact push rates on key numbers (3, 7, 10) and bookmaker DNP/void settlement.
Minimum effective independent game clusters N_eff >= pre-registered power threshold; two-sided t-interval / bootstrap 95% CI for skill score excludes zero.
Log every tested signal variant M; p-values must survive Benjamini-Hochberg FDR / Holm-Bonferroni correction across total trial count M.

validation_gates.gate_id: G7 · Joint Correlation CI & Exposure Cap
validation_gates.objective: Prevent parlay/combo ruin from misestimated rho.
validation_gates.pass_criteria: Parlay and prop-combo strategies must remain positive-EV evaluated at the conservative lower 95% bootstrap bound of leg correlation and obey per-game exposure caps.

validation_gates.objective: Confirm live operational skill with zero hindsight.
validation_gates.pass_criteria: Minimum 8 consecutive live NFL weeks of cryptographically hashed pre-kickoff predictions matching backtest calibration before leaderboard reward unlock.

correlations.structural_driver: Shared offensive efficiency, indoor/wind regime, and overtime scoring; non-linear across low vs. high total regimes.
correlations.estimator: Phi / tetrachoric correlation stratified by closing spread & total buckets with game-block bootstrap.

correlations.structural_driver: Direct accounting identity: WR1 yards are a subset of team passing yards weighted by Target Air Yards Share (TAY%) and xYAC.
correlations.estimator: Bivariate empirical copula on settled player prop residuals relative to pregame lines.

correlations.structural_driver: Passing TDs directly add 6+ points to team margin, elevating win probability.
correlations.estimator: Joint Bernoulli contingency table P(A & B) vs. P(A)P(B) across matched regular-season games.

correlations.structural_driver: 4th-quarter clock-killing game script when leading inflates RB carry share while suppressing dropbacks.
correlations.estimator: Conditional expectation E[RushAtt | Margin_Q3] and binary leg phi coefficient.

correlations.leg_a: Team A QB Passing Attempts Over
correlations.leg_b: Opposing Team B Points / WR1 Yards Over
correlations.structural_driver: Bidirectional shootout / trailing-script feedback loop increasing total play volume and neutral-to-negative pass rate.
correlations.estimator: Within-game residual Pearson correlation controlling for pregame total.

correlations.leg_a: Opposing CB1 Ruled Out (2nd/3rd-String Backup Active)
correlations.leg_b: Offense WR1/WR2 Receiving Yards & TD Over
correlations.structural_driver: Coverage drop-off in Average Cushion/Separation when boundary starter (e.g., Carlton Davis III) is replaced by backup.
correlations.estimator: Difference-in-differences on receiver target share & yards/route in CB1-Out vs. CB1-Active weeks.

correlations.leg_a: Offense >=2 OL Starters Out (2nd/3rd-String OL Active)
correlations.leg_b: Opposing Defense Sacks Over & QB Time-to-Throw Under
correlations.structural_driver: Pass-protection communication breakdowns force quicker releases (lower TT) or elevated sack rate.
correlations.estimator: Clustered regression of NGS Time-to-Throw & sack rate on active OL string-sum index.

correlations.leg_b: Full-Game Total Under & Same-Team WR1 Yards Under
correlations.structural_driver: Severe drop in CPOE/air-yards aggressiveness and conservative run-heavy play calling (modeled on BAL Week 9 QB chain).
correlations.estimator: Stratified event study on 3rd-string QB starts vs. closing market adjustments.

reward_governance.mechanism: Primary Ranking Metric: Proper Skill Score + CLV (Never Raw ROI)
reward_governance.anti_luck_effect: A lucky 6-leg parlay hit inflates short-term ROI by +500% with zero skill; Brier Skill Score and vig-free Closing Line Value weight every probability forecast equally and penalize overconfident misses.

reward_governance.mechanism: Market-Cohort Separation (Singles vs. Parlays vs. Prop Combos)
reward_governance.anti_luck_effect: Prevents high-kurtosis multi-leg combos (facing up to 27.79% NGCB parlay card hold) from distorting rankings of low-variance single-line originators.
Every parameter sweep and rejected model version per researcher increments M in the Benjamini-Hochberg FDR adjustment so brute-force luck mining cannot pass Gate G6.

reward_governance.mechanism: 8-Week Prospective Shadow Escrow Before Reward Vesting
reward_governance.anti_luck_effect: Backtest winners earn $0 / 0 credits at submission; rewards vest strictly after 8+ prospective live NFL weeks with pre-kickoff SHA-256 prediction hashes.
Strategies whose 95% game-clustered skill confidence intervals overlap share tier credit rather than crowning noise-driven #1 winners.
